transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um, well... I guess my sleep has just been really messed up lately. I just... I don't know, I'll be up half the night, my mind just kind of running. Or I'll wake up really early and just feel like I haven't slept at all. So, yeah. That's why I'm here.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot during the day?
Um... no, not really. I don't think I worry that much during the day. I just kind of... focus on my work, I guess. It's really just the sleeping part that's the issue.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?

Um... yeah, I guess so. Lately, I just... I wake up with this heavy, empty feeling. It's hard to explain. Even just sitting in my own condo, you know, the one I worked so hard for... it just makes me want to cry. So, yeah, I guess I have been feeling down.
Do you find pleasure in activities you used to enjoy?

Um... no. Not really. I just... I stopped going to my salsa class. And my paints are still just sitting out on the table at home, but... I don't know. I look at them and I just feel nothing. It's almost like they belong to somebody else. I just don't really have the energy for it.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite lately?

Um... yeah, I guess it's been a little off. I just... I keep skipping dinner lately. Or I'll just eat some crackers while I'm going over my budget notebook. I don't really want a full meal. And... I guess my work pants do feel a bit looser than they did a few weeks ago. So... yeah.
How long have you been feeling this way?

Um... I don't know exactly. It's been a while. Maybe... five months? Just this sort of heavy, guilty fog that won't lift. It... it definitely got a lot worse after I bought the condo, but... yeah, it's been around for about five months, I think.
Do you feel like you're moving slower than usual or having trouble sitting still?

Um... I guess a bit of both. Sometimes at work, I catch myself moving really slow... like I'll just stare at the calculator for a while before I even press a button. But then... I don't know, other times I just can't sit still. I end up just fidgeting with all the receipts. So... yeah.
Do you often feel guilty or worthless about things?

Um... yeah. I guess so. I just... I keep telling myself I was stupid to take on the mortgage. Like... I've let everyone down somehow. Even though... I mean, no bill is actually late or anything. But... yeah. I just feel bad about it.
Have you had any thoughts of not wanting to live or hurting yourself?
Um... no. I haven't. I mean... I feel bad, but I wouldn't do anything like that. So... no.
Have you experienced any significant loss of interest in activities that you normally find enjoyable for most of the day?

Um... yeah. I guess. I haven't been going to my salsa class lately. And... I don't know, my paints are just sitting out on the table at home. I look at them and... I just feel nothing. Like... like they belong to somebody else, I guess. So... yeah.
Do you feel like your depressed mood is interfering with your ability to function at work or at home?

Um... I guess so. I mean, I'm still getting to work every day. But... I've been making some mistakes lately. With the account reconciliations. My supervisor actually pulled me aside about it... so that wasn't great. And... I don't know, like I said, I've been avoiding the salsa class. And my friends, mostly. I just... I don't really feel like myself right now. So... yeah.
Do you feel like your depression is mild, moderate, or severe?
Um... I don't know. Moderate, maybe? I mean... it's not the worst it could be, I guess, but... it's definitely there. So... moderate, probably.
Have you had periods of at least two weeks where you didn't feel this depressed?

Um... I don't really know. I don't... keep track of the days like that. I guess maybe there are times when it's not as heavy, but... I'm not sure if it's for two whole weeks or anything. It just... kind of blends together.
Have you had any days in the past two weeks where you felt completely free of depression?
Um... no. Not completely. It's just... it's just been kind of there. Every day.
Have you had any thoughts of feeling hopeless about your future?

Um... maybe. I just... lately, I wake up with this really heavy, empty feeling. Like... I don't know. Even just sitting in my own condo, which I worked so hard for... it just makes me want to cry. So... yeah, I guess.
Have you had any difficulty concentrating on things like reading or watching TV?

Um... yeah. Mostly at work, though. I do bookkeeping, and... I don't know, the spreadsheets I usually handle fine just... kind of blur together now. I end up rereading the same row of numbers over and over... and I still don't really trust what I just entered. So... yeah. It's hard to focus.
Have you had any days in the past month where you were unable to get out of bed due to feeling depressed?
Um... no. Not unable to get out of bed. I mean... I still go to work. It's hard, but... I still get up.
Have you had any days in the past two weeks where you felt nearly free of depression, but still had some symptoms?
Um... no. Not really. It's just... been pretty much the same. Every day.
Have you had any thoughts of self-harm or suicide in the past two weeks?
Um... no. I haven't... I don't have thoughts like that.
Have you had any thoughts that you would be better off dead?
No... I mean, I feel bad, but... I don't think I'd be better off dead. No.
